NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

options.title: Dark background color
options.description: Pick a color, or type a solid color code like #000000. Black lets OLED screens turn those pixels off completely.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

options.title: Accent color
options.description: Pick a preset, or type a solid color code like #2D7FF9. TikTok original leaves the red as it is. TikTok's lighter and darker reds follow the color you pick.

options.title: Follow the wallpaper
options.description: On Android 12 and up, buttons and red text take the color of the phone's wallpaper theme and change when the wallpaper does, and the color above is not used. Android 11 and older keep TikTok's red. The soft see-through reds stay as they are.

patches.name: Advanced downloads
patches.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Video quality starts at Highest, retaining Metra's existing default. Configure these controls in Metra settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Always upload in HD
patches.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: App lock
patches.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Automatic video advance
patches.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Block P2P video relay
patches.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Block author button
patches.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Block popups
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Change lyrics provider
patches.description: Changes the lyrics provider to a custom one.

options.title: Lyrics provider host
options.description: The domain name or IP address of a custom lyrics provider.

patches.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches.description: Adds a note to Metra's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment send fix
patches.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment sort controls
patches.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Comment tools
patches.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Custom launcher icon
patches.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.

options.title: Icon style
options.description: TikTok colors keeps the icon as it is. Black background puts TikTok's note on pure black, and the two plain styles draw only the note in one color. Every style gets the themed icon.

options.title: Icon picture
options.description: Where to find a square PNG picture of your own, 432 to 1024 pixels on each side, to use instead of TikTok's note. Home screens trim icons to their own shape, so keep what matters in the middle two thirds. With a picture, the style only sets the color behind it and there's no themed icon. Leave it empty to keep the note.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Custom theme
patches.description: Applies a custom theme (defaults to amoled black)

options.title: Primary background color
options.description: The background color. Can be a hex color or a resource reference.

options.title: Override player gradient color
options.description: Apply primary background color to the player gradient color.

options.title: Accent color
options.description: The accent color ('Spotify green' by default).

options.title: Pressed accent color
options.description: The color when accented buttons are pressed.

patches.name: Device privacy guard
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Metra settings > App behavior. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Disable the long press repost
patches.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Double-tap controls
patches.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Enable voice comments
patches.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Expand activity list
patches.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Metra settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Metra settings > Feed controls.

patches.name: Feed tab navigation
patches.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on and stop For You reloading when you tap Home. Starts off, except holding Home to open Metra settings. Find it in Metra settings > Feed navigation.

patches.name: Feed text sizes
patches.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Fix Facebook login
patches.description: Fix logging in with Facebook when the app is patched by always opening the login in a web browser window.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Fix third party launchers widgets
patches.description: Fixes Spotify widgets not working in third party launchers, like Nova Launcher.

patches.name: Foldable split comment view
patches.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Follow diagnostics
patches.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches.description: Makes TikTok's Auto scroll action available without starting it automatically. Control it in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches.name: Hide already seen videos
patches.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Feed controls.

patches.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Each has its own switch, and both start off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide feed follow button
patches.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide feed save button
patches.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide feed search button
patches.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and App behavior for the rewards button.

patches.name: Hide inbox items
patches.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide inbox stories
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide search suggestions
patches.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts on, retaining Metra's existing default. Control it in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches.name: Hide video overlays
patches.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Keep a streak going
patches.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Keep the app language
patches.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: LIVE controls
patches.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches.name: Lift text length limits
patches.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Limit background traffic
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

options.title: Skip notification setup
options.description: With this on, the Limit background traffic switch in Metra settings also stops TikTok setting up notifications, so you won't get any, messages included. Turn the switch off or pause Metra to get them back.

patches.name: Location access governor
patches.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Long-press controls
patches.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Look like the store app
patches.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Mute feed videos
patches.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Metra's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Network request report
patches.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches.name: Not interested button
patches.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Notification controls
patches.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Playback quality
patches.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium

patches.name: Profile background
patches.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Region spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Metra settings > Interface. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches.name: Remove avatar rings
patches.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove card scanner assets
patches.description: Removes TikTok's bundled payment card scanner files. Keeps the content credential and runtime libraries loaded by other features, including photo comments. Card scanning may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches.name: Remove creation tools
patches.description: Removes the bundled face-detection model and effect-creation component. Keeps the shared photo and video editor needed by comment pictures. Face effects and effect creation may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches.name: Remove unused language packs
patches.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: The languages to keep, as short codes separated by commas, like en, es, pt, fr or de. Type all to keep every language. English is always kept.

patches.name: Repost diagnostics
patches.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resource and battery governor
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Run beside the store app
patches.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Metra settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Metra's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Share sheet tools
patches.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Show LIVE search
patches.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Show author region
patches.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches.name: Show engagement rate
patches.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Show exact counts
patches.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Show follow status
patches.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches.name: Show the progress bar
patches.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. A seek bar for video stories is there too.

patches.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Skip content warnings
patches.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Skip the splash ad
patches.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Skip update checks
patches.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Spoof device integrity
patches.description: Prevents Spotify's third-party fraud/device-integrity from detecting root/tamper signals or reporting device fingerprint and mobile integrity data back to Spotify's servers

patches.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Stop recording watch history
patches.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Stop saving search history
patches.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Stop search autoplay
patches.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Story controls
patches.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Subtitle tools
patches.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches.name: Swipe-left controls
patches.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Use non-personalized search
patches.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.
